title: NMR Serum Sample Preparation for NMR Metabolomics
author: Deanna Lanier
materials: Thaw samples on ice or at 4 °C

steps.title: Prepare NMR Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the NMR buffer solution and adjust pH.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 2321.55 mg of anhydrous NaH2PO4 and 802.25 mg of Na2HPO4 in 200 mL of D2O in a 250 ml volumetric flask.
Adjust the pH to 7.0 using HCl or NaOH.
Adjust the final volume to 250 mL with D2O and mix well.

steps.title: Thaw Serum Samples
steps.instruction: Thaw the serum samples on ice or at 4 °C.

steps.title: Protein Precipitation with Methanol
steps.instruction: Add MeOH to samples on ice at a 3:1 methanol-to-sample ratio.

substeps.instruction: For pre-challenge samples: add 750 µL MeOH to 250 µL neat sera.
For post-challenge samples: add 1200 µL MeOH to 400 µL neat sera.

steps.title: Incubate and Centrifuge Samples
steps.instruction: Vortex and freeze the samples to precipitate proteins, then centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the samples and incubate at -20 °C for 00:20:00.
Centrifuge the samples at 16000 rcf for 00:30:00.

steps.title: Collect Supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant of each sample to a new tube.

steps.title: Dry Samples
steps.instruction: Dry the samples in a speed-vac concentrator (time depends on sample condition).

substeps.instruction: Store the dry pellets in -80 °C if needed.

steps.title: Resuspend Pellets
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellets using the prepared NMR buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µL of NMR buffer to each sample to resuspend the pellets.

steps.title: Final Sample Processing
steps.instruction: Homogenize and prepare the sample for the NMR tube.

steps.title: Add Internal Standard and Transfer
steps.instruction: Add the DSS-D6 internal standard and transfer to the NMR tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 833.25 µL of 0.1 DSS-D6 stock solution (which is 1/3 of 1mM DSS when mixed with sample).
Transfer 580 µL into a 5-mm NMR tube.
